0022600017.text: The Nets (0-3, 5th in the Atlantic and 14th in the East) are looking for their first win of the season against a Pistons side that is 3-0, sits 1st in the Central and East, and is on a three-game winning streak. Brooklyn is without Tyler Bilodeau, who is out with a shoulder sprain, and Egor Demin is day-to-day with a leg bruise and a game-time decision, while Detroit will be without Jalen Duren, who is out with a hamstring strain. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Nets lost the season series 1-3, including a 138-100 defeat in Brooklyn on March 10, 2026.
